description: KoSIT XRechnung visualization, stage 1: ubl-invoice-xr.xsl (XSLT 2.0) maps each UBL Invoice of the KoSIT test suite to the intermediate xr:invoice XML. bench/xrechnung-stage1.sh writes the same stage's go-xml output as the sources of xrechnung-html (benchrun does not chain). Normalise is whitespace because xsl:output indent="yes" indents by 2 in go-xml and 3 in Saxon; the outputs are otherwise byte-equal. xsltproc is omitted: the stylesheet is XSLT 2.0.
